name: C11_PI_OCTAHEDRON_CORE_MODULATOR_GATE_V1

definition: C is a connected authoritative C11 PI residual component produced by the already-frozen fixed-pair propagation/normalization stack.
C is noncontradictory and not L3_READY.
C contains a graph-discoverable literal induced subgraph H isomorphic to K_{2,2,2}.
Literal means six actual residual vertices, partitionable into three independent pairs with all cross-part edges present; no contraction/branch-set expansion is used for the core.
explicitly_excluded: octahedron minors represented only by non-singleton branch sets without a literal six-vertex K_{2,2,2} core

algorithm: Enumerate all six-vertex subsets of C.
For each subset enumerate the constant number of partitions into three unordered pairs.
Accept H exactly when each pair is a nonedge and every cross-part pair is an edge.
octahedron_core_discovery.complexity: O(n^6) subset enumeration times a constant-size isomorphism test; polynomial.

core_branching.accepted_assignments: Exactly the assignments phi:H->[4] that respect every current list L(v) and are proper on every edge of H.
core_branching.enumeration: Direct explicit enumeration from graph+lists; no extension oracle and no hidden global coloring.
core_branching.quantifier: EVERY proper list-respecting phi(H) must be structurally classified. Existence of one good core coloring is insufficient for O1.

per_core_assignment_stack.step_1: Fix all six colors phi(v), v in H.
per_core_assignment_stack.step_2: Apply only the already-frozen deterministic propagation/normalization stack.
per_core_assignment_stack.step_3: If exact contradiction arises, classify branch CONTRADICTION.
per_core_assignment_stack.step_4: Otherwise remove fixed/forced vertices and decompose the surviving undecided graph into connected components.
per_core_assignment_stack.step_5: For each component D first test L3_READY by global missing color.
per_core_assignment_stack.step_6: If not L3_READY, test tw(D)<=3 and require a verified width-3 decomposition before calling the frozen TW3 arbitrary-list DP.
per_core_assignment_stack.branch_closed_iff: Every surviving component is CONTRADICTION, L3_READY, or TW3_LIST_READY.

exact_feasibility_logic.statement: C is list-colorable iff at least one proper list-respecting core assignment phi has every surviving post-propagation component colorable by the frozen terminal stack.
exact_feasibility_logic.UNSAT_requirement: To certify C uncolorable by this modulator procedure, every proper core assignment must be closed and every one must be rejected by contradiction/List-3/TW3 DP.
exact_feasibility_logic.SAT_requirement: A single closed core branch with reconstructed downstream colorings yields a full coloring certificate.
exact_feasibility_logic.polynomiality_if_core_is_certified: At most 4096 core assignments; each branch performs polynomial frozen propagation, component decomposition, List-3 tests/solves, fixed-k treewidth-3 recognition/decomposition, bounded-state DP, and reconstruction.

O1_OCTAHEDRON_CORE_TERMINAL_UNIVERSAL.label: O1_OCTAHEDRON_CORE_TERMINAL_UNIVERSAL
pass_requires: A theorem/proof-carrying argument for every residual in AUTHORITATIVE_LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_C11_RESIDUALS.
A polynomial graph-only rule discovering at least one suitable literal octahedron core H for each such residual.
For the selected H, EVERY proper list-respecting core assignment phi closes under CONTRADICTION/L3_READY/TW3_LIST_READY after frozen propagation.
Exact reconstruction/UNSAT aggregation and polynomial accounting.
consequence_ceiling: The authoritative literal-OCTAHEDRON X2 family becomes polynomially solvable by a constant-size certified structural modulator.
This does not resolve K5, Wagner V8, prism, or nonliteral octahedron-minor families.
Global PI discovery and P3 may be promoted only if all remaining authoritative residual families are separately covered.

O2_OCTAHEDRON_ATTACHMENT_ESCAPE.label: O2_OCTAHEDRON_ATTACHMENT_ESCAPE
O2_OCTAHEDRON_ATTACHMENT_ESCAPE.condition: There exists an authoritative literal-octahedron residual C, a certified literal core H, and a proper list-respecting coloring phi of H such that frozen propagation leaves a surviving connected component D outside the old terminal stack.
certificate: exact pre-core residual C and exact lists
literal induced octahedron core H and its three-part partition
exact proper list-respecting core assignment phi
complete frozen propagation transcript after fixing phi
exact surviving connected component D and exact lists
D is NOT_L3_READY with union of lists [4]
D has tw(D)>3 certified by an explicit minor model of one frozen forbidden graph in {K5,OCTAHEDRON,WAGNER_V8,PENTAGONAL_PRISM}
independent verification of all branch sets and required cross edges
O2_OCTAHEDRON_ATTACHMENT_ESCAPE.interpretation: Establishes only that a literal octahedron core is not a universal one-shot modulator to the current {Contradiction,List-3,TW3} terminal stack.

O3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: O3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
O3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither a universal O1 theorem nor a complete authoritative O2 escape certificate is established.
O3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.interpretation: No hardness, lower-bound, or impossibility conclusion.

expected: Color 1 remains available at z in every branch.
Post-core residual is singleton z and therefore terminal.
Current X2 witness is polynomially resolved but O1 is not thereby established.

mandatory_quantifier_control.requirement: Provide a synthetic literal-octahedron residual in which at least one proper core coloring closes but another proper core coloring leaves a certified nonterminal attachment; checker must reject universal closure for that H.
mandatory_quantifier_control.purpose: Prevent accidental replacement of FOR EVERY proper phi(H) by EXISTS a good phi(H).

anti_cheat: Do not choose core colors using an extension oracle.
Do not accept one successful core coloring as O1.
Do not call arbitrary six vertices a core; H must be a literal induced K_{2,2,2}.
Do not promote a failed TW3 heuristic search to O2; post-core tw(D)>3 needs an explicit frozen forbidden-minor model.
Do not generalize O1 to K5, Wagner V8, pentagonal prism, or nonliteral octahedron-minor branches.
Do not open tw4, size-2 backdoors, separator repair, or new state language.
forbidden: claim universal resolution of all X2 forbidden-minor types
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only literal certified OCTAHEDRON cores and stop at O1/O2/O3.
